answer.reason: JER 28 tells of Hananiah the prophet's false prophecy, his breaking of Jeremiah's yoke, and his death; JER 36:12 names a different Hananiah (father of Zedekiah).

clauses.english: prophesied that the LORD would break the yoke of Babylon within two years
clauses.quote: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

clauses.english: broke the yoke from off Jeremiah's neck
clauses.quote: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.

clauses.english: was told by Jeremiah that the LORD had not sent him, and died that same year
clauses.quote: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

doubts: JER 36:12 is marked but names Hananiah the father of Zedekiah, a different person; left out.
JER 28:1 spells the father's name Azur, while the summary has Azzur.
